purpose: Phase-6D tumour-response CONTEXT profiles per species + cell model. B16 / B16BL6 / B16-F10 are INDEPENDENT tumour-response contexts and are never silently merged. A tumour profile runs only when its Phase-6C population input is active (no tumour response without population input). Human melanoma tumour response is predictive-exploratory / UNAVAILABLE (never a validated clinical claim); rat is NOT_REPORTED (skin permeation only).

mouse_b16bl6_tumor.disease_context: cutaneous melanoma (canonical mouse line; Chen 2012 in vivo antimelanoma PD)
mouse_b16bl6_tumor.uncertainty: Treatment-effect DIRECTION and the cationic > (anionic / neutral) RANKING (and NLC over free tripterine) are experimentally supported (Chen 2012, in vivo B16BL6). Exact tumour volume / growth curve / regression rate / doubling time / dose-response / long-term recurrence are NOT_REPORTED; burden is normalized schematic.

mouse_b16_tumor.uncertainty: B16 free-celastrol tumour-growth inhibition + apoptosis-related loss are qualitatively reported; exact quantitative tumour data NOT_REPORTED. Kept separate from B16BL6 - parameters are never copied across.

mouse_b16f10_tumor.disease_context: cutaneous melanoma (B16-F10; viability / proliferation / apoptosis / cell-cycle, PI3K/AKT/mTOR)
mouse_b16f10_tumor.uncertainty: B16-F10 reduced viability / proliferation suppression / apoptosis / cell-cycle effects are qualitatively reported; Phase 6D uses only growth pressure, loss pressure, and treatment-response direction (NOT invasion / metastasis / migration). Exact quantitative data NOT_REPORTED. Kept separate from B16 / B16BL6.

human_melanoma_tumor.disease_context: human skin (canonical human context = HaCaT keratinocyte; no human melanoma tumour dataset)
human_melanoma_tumor.uncertainty: No validated human melanoma tumour response is inferred from mouse studies. The canonical human context (HaCaT keratinocyte) has NO active melanoma population, so the tumour engine is UNAVAILABLE at runtime; a human predictive-exploratory mode would require an active human melanoma population (absent).
human_melanoma_tumor.human_translation_warning: This tumour-response trajectory is a mechanistic visualization derived from preclinical evidence and is not validated for human clinical response.
human_melanoma_tumor.reason: no active human melanoma population (population-gated) -> UNAVAILABLE

rat_tumor.disease_context: ex vivo rat skin (permeation reference; no tumour dataset)
rat_tumor.uncertainty: Rat data support skin permeation only; no rat melanoma tumour evidence. A rat tumour regression is never generated from skin-permeation evidence alone.

context_rules.population_gated: A tumour profile runs only when its Phase-6C population input is active (no tumour response without population input).
context_rules.no_silent_transfer: B16 / B16BL6 / B16-F10 tumour-response evidence is never merged; cross-cell-model use requires an explicit CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION record.
context_rules.no_human_experimental: No human EXPERIMENTAL tumour label is derived from mouse data; human is predictive-exploratory / UNAVAILABLE.
context_rules.no_rat_fallback: Rat has no default melanoma tumour model.
